title: Warning to the Rich, Patience in Suffering, The Prayer of Faith

questions.question: Come now, you ____, weep and howl for the miseries that are coming upon you.
questions.explanation: James 5:1 (ESV): "Come now, you rich, weep and howl for the miseries that are coming upon you."

questions.question: Your riches have rotted and your garments are ____-eaten.
questions.explanation: James 5:2 (ESV): "Your riches have rotted and your garments are moth-eaten."

questions.question: Your gold and silver have ____, and their corrosion will be evidence against you and will eat your flesh like fire.
questions.explanation: James 5:3 (ESV): "Your gold and silver have corroded, and their corrosion will be evidence against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up treasure in the last days."

questions.question: Behold, the ____ of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you kept back by fraud, are crying out against you,
questions.explanation: James 5:4 (ESV): "Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you kept back by fraud, are crying out against you, and the cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of hosts."

questions.question: You have lived on the earth in luxury and in self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts in a day of ____.
questions.explanation: James 5:5 (ESV): "You have lived on the earth in luxury and in self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts in a day of slaughter."

questions.question: Be patient, therefore, brothers, until the coming of the ____.
questions.explanation: James 5:7 (ESV): "Be patient, therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord."

questions.question: See how the ____ waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient about it, until it receives the early and the late rains.
questions.explanation: James 5:7 (ESV): "...See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient about it, until it receives the early and the late rains."

questions.question: Do not ____ against one another, brothers, so that you may not be judged; behold, the Judge is standing at the door.
questions.explanation: James 5:9 (ESV): "Do not grumble against one another, brothers, so that you may not be judged; behold, the Judge is standing at the door."

questions.question: As an example of suffering and patience, brothers, take the ____ who spoke in the name of the Lord.
questions.explanation: James 5:10 (ESV): "As an example of suffering and patience, brothers, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord."

questions.question: Behold, we consider those blessed who remained steadfast. You have heard of the steadfastness of ____, and you have seen the purpose of the Lord...
questions.explanation: James 5:11 (ESV): "Behold, we consider those blessed who remained steadfast. You have heard of the steadfastness of Job, and you have seen the purpose of the Lord, how the Lord is compassionate and merciful."

questions.question: But above all, my brothers, do not ____, either by heaven or by earth or by any other oath, but let your "yes" be yes and your "no" be no...
questions.explanation: James 5:12 (ESV): "But above all, my brothers, do not swear, either by heaven or by earth or by any other oath, but let your 'yes' be yes and your 'no' be no, so that you may not fall under condemnation."

questions.question: Is anyone among you sick? Let him call for the ____ of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.
questions.explanation: James 5:14 (ESV): "Is anyone among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord."

questions.question: And the prayer of ____ will save the one who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. And if he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
questions.explanation: James 5:15 (ESV): "And the prayer of faith will save the one who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. And if he has committed sins, he will be forgiven."

questions.question: Therefore, confess your ____ to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed.
questions.explanation: James 5:16 (ESV): "Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person has great power as it is working."

questions.question: ____ was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain, and for three years and six months it did not rain on the earth.
questions.explanation: James 5:17 (ESV): "Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain, and for three years and six months it did not rain on the earth."

key_verse_text: Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person has great power as it is working.
